primary_decision: Home uses Reverse: 1999 solid ticket + two side-by-side destinations + one wide destination; character refitting uses Zenless Zone Zero horizontal character/scene and fixed right-side information. Each page has one main layout source.
supersedes: V7 open thin white-text home navigation. Increasing text size alone does not sufficiently subordinate the wallpaper.
theme: Retained winter camp wallpaper, cream printed-paper action surfaces, graphite secondary surfaces, one warm camp-lamp accent; no Persona brand red/hand or ZZZ neon green copied.
coordinates_notice: Original-image coordinates are visual estimates; project layout percentages, palette and animation numbers are proposed adaptations, not official game specs.
scope: Research records only. No game source, browser operation, checks, tests, build, or third-party binary files saved.

visible_observations: Main action is a light cream solid ticket with dark text
Secondary destinations use darker surfaces and lighter text/edges
Two destinations share a row beneath primary action
A wider lower destination completes the action group
Resources have a dark solid strip
Source has left utility entries and upper activity banners which the project will reduce
sources.project_mapping: Concentrate resources, title, large sortie ticket, refit/warehouse pair, wide supply entry and utility baseline into x=68%-95% of the existing winter-camp wallpaper.

visible_observations: Character is not enclosed in a vertical portrait box
Character/background occupies the left part of a wide screen
One fixed information surface spans approximately x=630 to x=1120
Character selector is above the information area
Base Stats, Skills and Equipment form a single lower tab row
Stat labels and values follow consistent two-column alignment
sources.project_mapping: Use horizontal winter-camp character scenery across left 62%, one fixed information surface at x=64%-95%, top character switching and bottom local tabs.

visible_observations: Reclining character, couch and brick wall form a horizontal scene
A fixed Events panel sits at the right
Current Options entry has a bright solid selected background
sources.project_mapping: Use seated/reclining character plus winter camp environment as a wide scene; the right-side region becomes project character information.
sources.semantic_limit: The original right-side Events panel is not a character stat panel; using it for project information is an adaptation.

visible_observations: Skill is visibly distinct from the other commands
Current command combines strong foreground/background contrast with one direction marker
Only one current menu item has the selection treatment
sources.project_mapping: Cream solid selected surface with dark text and one warm marker. Borrow state contrast only; no brand hand, red screen, ransom-note lettering, or distorted composition.
Shop page only: horizontal categories, large product grid, title top / image center / price bottom; adapt surfaces to shared winter-camp paper and graphite palette.
Warehouse full page only: local category navigation plus continuous grid; selected category uses V8 high-contrast treatment, object rarity remains confined to object-related visuals.
